svg.title: Addition is immediate. Product arrays obey (g ∗x h)(A) = P B∪C=A x|B∩C|g(B)h(C). At zero only disjoint pairs remain; overlapping substituted products vanish by z2 i = 0. Hence substitu- tion is multiplicative, maps constants to scalars and multiplies paid bounds. For countable sums with summable paid bounds, coefficientwise dominated convergence and the finite subset sum give Sz(P n fn) = P n Sz(fn). Apply this to exponential terms bounded by cn/n! to obtain
